svg.title: Backprop on the 2-2-1 network
svg.desc: Forward values in blue, deltas in red, updated weights in green, for input (1, 0), target 1, learning rate 0.5.
svg.text: Input x = (1, 0), target y = 1, sigmoid everywhere, learning rate 0.5
δj​ = f'(zj​) × (δo​ woj​), new w = w − 0.5 × δ × (signal entering the weight); w12​ and w22​ stay the same
red: deltas, sent back along dashed arrows
green: value after one update (old weights used throughout)
